kids.content: The distributed middleware architecture of the application was based on the framework described in [10]. The physics of the scene was simulated using the Bullet Physics Library2. Simplified forms of non-convex pieces and holes were designed for the physics simulation in order to facilitate their manipulation, as the Bullet Physics Library does not handle nonconvex meshes properly.

Fig. 2. on Top: six holes complexity task description. On Bottom: two holes complexity task description In both cases, twelve pieces were involved, six ”fitters” to place in the holed box and six ”non-fitters” to place in the disposal zone.
